pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Slider: one focusable role=slider with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin (0 when clearable), aria-valuemax, and aria-valuetext such as '3.5 of 5'. Chosen over the radio group pattern because half steps and clearing are one value on a range and the control is a single tab stop. Display mode is role=img named by the label and the value text.

roles.role: none (decorative; the control announces the value)

aria.value: 0 (or one step when not clearable) and max
the score and its text ('3.5 of 5', 'No rating', or valueText)
true when disabled (also removed from the tab order)
validation state; help text and error

keyboard.action: Increase by one step (ArrowLeft increases in right-to-left).
Increase or decrease by one whole symbol.
Lowest value (no rating when clearable) or the maximum.
Set that many symbols (up to max).

focus: One tab stop; clicking a symbol focuses the control. Display mode is not focusable.
notes: Filled and empty symbols differ in shape (solid and outline), not only in color (WCAG 1.4.1).
Each symbol is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels (WCAG 2.5.8).
Clearing announces 'Rating cleared' through the polite live region.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
